request: How much have first-of-class Navy ships overrun their cost estimates?
escalation_reason: The quick pass answered only part of the question.

reply.reply: The clearest observed figure is about **70% cost growth** for the first LPD-17, based on CBO testimony from 2007 as reported by CRS in 2012 (CRS RL34476, PDF p. 22). This is not a cross-program average: the reports checked did not substantiate comparable actual first-ship overruns across Navy shipbuilding programs. Separately, a 2020 CBO analysis forecast the first ten FFG-62s would cost 40% more to build than the Navy estimated; that is a forecast, not an actual overrun (CRS R44972, PDF p. 39). See the [brief](output/briefs/case-20261025-153042-4e45.html) for details.
reply.reasoning: The brief verifies one observed first-of-class overrun figure and one distinct forecast, but cannot establish the requested cross-program actual comparison.
